style: Say firmly but kindly, like a ship captain giving clear directions
lines: Slide the lens with the arrow buttons. Watch which chords fit and which notes light up.
Two lenses. Slide the green one too. A gold bracket marks a chord that fits both keys.
Tap Reps, then tap a rep tile to start a set.
Pick the number, then the quality, then press Check.
Slide the lens to the key, then press Lock in.
Read the last two chords, then tap the cadence name.
Slide each lens to its key and press its Lock in. Then tap the pivot chord.
That's it.
Some notes are still outside the lens.
Every note fits, but it doesn't end on home. Which key ends here?
That one fits both keys too, but the music hasn't turned yet. Look later.
Too late. The music already turned. Look one chord earlier.
That chord is still only in the first key. Look later.
Close. Look at the top note of the last chord.
It ends on vi, not V.
Read the last two numerals again.
Number right, quality wrong.
Quality right, number wrong.
Count the letter names and half steps again.
Pick a number and a quality first.
Pick a cadence first.
Lock in both keys first. Then tap the pivot chord.
Opening key locked. Set the green lens and press its Lock in.
Closing key locked. Set the blue lens and press its Lock in.
Both keys locked. Tap the pivot chord.
Find the opening home chord. Set the blue lens and press its Lock in.
Find the closing home chord. Set the green lens and press its Lock in.
Set complete. Tap Next rep to start the next set.
Progress cleared. Tap a rep tile to start again.
Count the letter names, counting both notes.
Now count half steps on the keyboard.
Find a note with a sharp or flat. Which keys have it?
Look at the last chord or note. Is it home?
Read the numerals of the last two chords.
Is the tonic on top at the end?
Find the first chord only the second lens fits.
The pivot is just before it.
Set complete. Tap Reps to revisit a set.
All 25 reps saved. Tap Reps to revisit a set.
